GOOD TO KNOW 07 / 07

Questions,
answered.

Everything you need to feel ready for your visit.

Who can use Carevia?

Adults aged 18 and over can create an account. Parents and legal guardians can add children and other dependants and book on their behalf. You need to be in a supported country during your visit.

Which countries are supported?

Availability depends on your country and the doctor’s registration. Confirm availability for your country before booking.

Can I get a prescription or certificate?

A doctor may issue prescriptions, certificates and referrals when clinically appropriate, after assessing you during your consultation.

What happens if the video connection fails?

You can rebook for free. Contact support for help arranging another consultation.

How are recordings handled?

Your written consultation summary and issued documents are saved in your account. Contact support before your visit for details about audio or video recording.

NEED URGENT HELP?

Carevia isn’t an emergency service.

In an emergency, call 112 or go to your nearest emergency department.

Call 112 ↗
